flows.description: Plan stage: turns a new issue into a scoped plan that respects Abhiverse's security invariants. Plans only, never code.
flows.name: abhiverse-plan

flows.description: Create/verify stage: gate-aware merge request review. Asks the one question that matters: can this change weaken a security invariant?
flows.name: abhiverse-review

flows.description: Verify stage: when a pipeline fails, reads the failing jobs and opens a fix merge request (never touches the security invariants to make tests pass).
flows.name: abhiverse-fix

flows.description: Secure stage: triages secret-detection, semgrep, cargo-audit and trivy findings by reachability and opens remediation merge requests. Dismisses nothing itself.
flows.name: abhiverse-secure

flows.description: Release/monitor stage: after a pipeline on main, checks the live service and posts the release summary; on failure, opens an incident.
flows.name: abhiverse-release
